title: No Central Server
description: Capture the fallback coordinator and obtain the dependency map.
objective: Recover evidence at Authoritative record / Capture controller at Response controller
condition: All required objectives must be secured. Optional archives pay extra. Quiet bonus uses peak trace.
aftermath: There is no master switch. Publication, independent infrastructure and command seizure each attack a different dependency.
